x: Once off, however, they tore down the Embankment like the wind, and as the field reached the coloured lights of Albert Bridge, twinklingly reflected in the dark Thames below, our Belgrave heroes - McDonald, Plummer, 'Boofer' Bruce, etc. - could be seen bounding along like young gazelles.

Cannily plugging away in the middle of the bunch as the early jockeying for positions takes place, 'Boofer' Bruce can be seen, shepherding along his latest handicap springer. A mile out, along Parkside, and John Wasbrough makes a break taking Eddie Thorp with him.
This is normally the time one comes across "Glimpy" Jones, Alf Wilkins, Cyril Gittens, "Boofer" Bruce, etc. but familiar faces are few and far between on this trip.
Approaching his advisor "Boofer" Bruce down the back straight with five and a half laps to go the plan became apparent and a Brendan Foster-like surge left an ever-widening void behind.
